summary: The Zcash ETF (ZCSH, NYSE Arca) filed an 8-K reporting that sponsor Grayscale Investments Sponsors, LLC, on the Trust's behalf, entered a Sixth Amendment to the Master Custody Service Agreement on September 29, 2026, adding Anchorage Digital Bank N.A., an OCC-chartered national trust bank, as an additional custodian for a portion of the Trust's ZEC holdings. Coinbase Custody Trust Company, LLC remains primary custodian; the arrangement is unaffected. Allocation amounts are at the Sponsor's sole discretion and remain undetermined. This is a routine custody-services contract, not a special situation. Watch operational custody concentration and any future ZEC reallocation disclosures.
